{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Identify duplicates
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {duplicate_patients['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sample_seq for each duplicate patient
print("\nHighest sample_seq per patient (for deduplication):")
duplicate_patients_grouped = duplicate_patients.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(duplicate_patients_grouped.head())

# Check if there are rows with biomarker_baseline = -999
print("\nNumber of rows with biomarker_baseline = -999:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
